properties.site-address: Brewhouse Bank A (northern parcel), North Shields
properties.notes: Allocated for mixed-use (re)development through Local Plan. Remaining element of land at Brewhouse Bank A not subject to permitted application (15/00577/OUT). Preferred development as part of a comprehensive scheme - potentially including sites 280 to 285. Considered with regard to complexity of land ownership, potential contamination and employment land supply.
